authprobe.title: AuthProbe
authprobe.server.add.tip: Add a server with its own nicks and passwords
authprobe.chat.logsOnly.tip: Show only [AuthProbe] lines in the pane. Available while debug logs are on
authprobe.button.import.tip: Import nicks and passwords from .txt (replaces current profiles)
authprobe.import.title: AuthProbe — import nicks and passwords
authprobe.import.hint: Format: nick | comment, then passwords one per line; blank lines are ignored
authprobe.import.browse.tip: Choose a .txt file; it only fills the path, then press Replace or Add
authprobe.import.replace.tip: Delete the current nicknames of this server and replace them with the imported ones
authprobe.import.add.tip: Add new nicknames without deleting existing ones; duplicates get their missing passwords merged
authprobe.import.none: No nicknames found in the file
authprobe.import.dialogFailed: Could not open the file dialog: %s
authprobe.import.duplicates: all nicknames are already present — nothing added
authprobe.option.mode.tip: Which login command to send: /l or /login
authprobe.option.smartdelay.tip: The server sets the pace: a "wait N s" line is honored, the same password is re-sent and the try is not spent. The Delay button is inactive while this is on
authprobe.option.delay.tip: Pause between sends so the server does not treat them as flood
authprobe.option.timeout.tip: How long to wait for an answer before the attempt is spent. If the server says it is checking the password, the wait extends to the hold limit
authprobe.option.hold.tip: How long to wait after a "checking password" line before the password is spent. Only applies once the server said it is checking the password
authprobe.option.reconnect.tip: Delay before reconnecting automatically after a kick
authprobe.option.autostart.tip: Start probing as soon as the server connection is up
authprobe.option.autoswap.tip: Switch to the next nickname and connect by itself. Off — you change the nick, the mod stops and shows the report
authprobe.option.autoreconnect.tip: Reconnect after a kick; on IP ban, VPN/proxy filter or timeout, change proxy first
authprobe.option.debug.tip: Print the password of every attempt to chat in yellow (local only); the same lines are mirrored into the Server chat pane
authprobe.option.mod.tip: Disable chat capture, command interception and probing for normal play
authprobe.option.macro.tip: Allow the keybind to run .start/.go. Bind it in Options → Controls → AuthProbe
authprobe.button.start.tip: Save settings, swap the session and connect
authprobe.button.stop.tip: Stop the run and print the position
authprobe.button.patterns.tip: Server message patterns and kick reasons
authprobe.button.menu.tip: Save and return to the title screen
authprobe.patterns.title: Message patterns
authprobe.pick.title: Add line to patterns
authprobe.pick.hint: pick a bank — the line is added to the active server
authprobe.patterns.kick.desc: Limit: server refused because of flood
authprobe.patterns.nickonline.desc: Nick is already online → was-online mark
authprobe.patterns.nickinvalid.desc: Server rejected the name → invalid-nick mark
authprobe.patterns.proxykicks.desc: IP ban, VPN/proxy, timeout → change proxy
authprobe.patterns.advanced.warning: Advanced: short and generic words match ordinary chat
authprobe.patterns.option.twofactor.tip: Watch for login-confirmation requests. After .start it always works while this is on
authprobe.patterns.option.twobefore.tip: Check 2FA before the first password is sent. A server broadcast will mark every nickname
Pause the run when the server asks for a captcha before the first send. No password is spent
authprobe.patterns.clearMarks.tip: Remove every skip mark of the current server
authprobe.status.title: AuthProbe - disconnected
authprobe.status.run: Nicks done: %s · started at #%s · interrupted at #%s of %s
authprobe.status.run.done: Nicks done: %s · started at #%s · finished at #%s of %s
authprobe.nick.add.tip: Add a nickname with its own password list
authprobe.nick.clear.tip: Delete all profiles of this server
authprobe.nick.delete2fa.tip: Delete every profile marked 2FA (click twice to confirm)
authprobe.nick.deleteFailed.tip: Delete profiles where no password worked (click twice to confirm)
authprobe.nick.export.tip: Export %s successful nicknames (nick:password) from all servers to config/authprobe-success.txt
authprobe.nick.export.none: There are no successful nicknames yet
authprobe.nick.sort.tip: Sort profiles: 2FA → invalid nick → passwords exhausted → successful → online → unmarked
authprobe.nick.sort.locked: Cannot sort while the probe is running
authprobe.nick.sort.none: Nothing to sort: at least two profiles are needed
authprobe.nick.sort.same: the order is already like this
authprobe.nick.skip.clear.tip: Clear the mark and the result
authprobe.option.proxy.tip: Route the connection through a proxy from the list
authprobe.option.proxy.settings.tip: Open the proxy list and checker
authprobe.proxy.title: Proxy
authprobe.proxy.needAddress: set a valid server address first
